press_references.value: EBRD backs Egypt’s first private-to-private electricity contracts

partnership_announcements.description: KarmSolar, AMEA Power, TAQA PV, and Enara have each entered into new private-to-private electricity contracts with major industrial consumers in Egypt, enabled by a new regulatory framework and supported by EBRD. These partnerships mark the first time private electricity generators can sell directly to private consumers in Egypt, fostering competition and investment in renewables.

partnership_announcements.description: KarmSolar and Daltex have partnered to expand the Farafra Solar Grid, tripling its energy capacity to 8.37 MVA. This strategic partnership aims to provide sustainable energy solutions for agricultural businesses in Egypt.

overview_description.description:
The company is an owner of a transdisciplinary utility platform designed to create solar energy for a variety of businesses and neighborhoods.

Through developing unique approaches to each project, we develop systems that harness the power of the sun and replace diesel-powered processes and thereby producing energy that is affordable, stable, reliable, and environmentally friendly.

KarmSolar was established on October 23, 2011 by Ahmed Zahran and Tamer Essawy in Cairo, Al Qahirah.

about_short_description.short_description: KarmSolar is a private off-grid solar energy integrator in Egypt.

product.name: Solar Power Generation Stations
product.description: Solar power stations designed, owned, and operated by KarmSolar provide businesses with renewable energy either connected to the national grid or functioning independently without upfront investment.

product.name: Private Power Distribution Networks
product.description: KarmSolar supplies electricity through private distribution networks in urban and remote areas, managing infrastructure, metering, billing, and customer support for commercial and residential developments.

product.name: Micro-grids
product.description: Micro-grids are off-grid energy systems combining solar PV, battery storage, and diesel generators to provide reliable electricity to businesses and communities in remote areas.

product.name: KarmWater Solar-Powered Water Desalination
product.description: KarmWater offers solar-powered desalination plants that provide clean freshwater to businesses in remote or water-scarce areas under Water Purchase Agreements without upfront client investment.

product.name: KarmCharge EV Charging Infrastructure
product.description: KarmCharge develops and operates electric vehicle charging stations integrated into commercial and public locations across Egypt, leveraging KarmSolar’s electricity distribution network.

product.name: Karm Architecture Lab (KAL)
product.description: KAL provides architectural design and consultancy focused on sustainable, high-performance buildings and master planning that integrate environmental and cultural context.
